asked.item: Did I do something wrong when typing the caption
Caption is gone from the draft
How to get the caption back before posting

verdict.reason: The help pages state directly that captions are not carried over when a TikTok post is published as a draft, and give the step to re-enter the caption in the TikTok app.

steps.text: Captions are not carried over when you publish a TikTok post as a draft.
This is a TikTok API limitation.
After the draft is created, open the TikTok app and re-enter your caption before publishing the draft.
The draft appears in the TikTok app's notifications, not in the standard Drafts folder in your profile. Look for a notification from TikTok about your draft.
